jira_summaries.title: Comment and mention support
jira_summaries.business_objective: Enable users to add comments and mention other users within the system, improving collaboration and communication on issues.
key_requirements: Allow users to post comments on issues.
Ensure comments are visible in the issue activity feed.
major_implementation_details: Integrate comment functionality into the issue detail view.
Implement mention parsing and user lookup.
Update notification system to handle mentions.
Ensure data model supports threaded or flat comments as required.
jira_summaries.contextualized_summary: This ticket introduces support for commenting and user mentions on issues, aiming to enhance team collaboration and communication. The expected behavior is that users can add comments and mention others, triggering notifications and improving workflow transparency. The impacted area is the issue detail interface and notification system. This feature is relevant for both implementation and testing to ensure seamless user experience and correct notification delivery.
